resolutions.researcher_notes: Original current_ref (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/.../t16217273.shtml) is dead from this environment (ConnectTimeout, matches the known geo-blocked-host list); checked web.archive.org (20250413122044 snapshot exists and loads) but it turns out to be a generic province-wide 2023 energy-infrastructure work-plan notice with no segment-specific text, so not usable as a targeted cite -- replaced with two independent, verified, segment-relevant sources instead. (1) Sina/People's Daily wire (k.sina.com.cn), 2022-12-21: reports the 2022-12-20 groundbreaking ceremony (开工仪式) for '广西燃气集团来宾天然气支线管道工程暨三江口新区天然气管道项目' at Liumian village, Chengxiang town, Xingbin District -- direct evidence construction of this branch program began. (2) Laibin Daily (epaper.lbnews.com.cn), 2023-08-09: official public notice that the EIA report for this EXACT segment '广西天然气支线管网项目来宾天然气支线管道工程（兴宾-武宣段）' had been completed, confirming the segment is an active, moving project (not shelved) as of mid-2023. Neither pins 'construction' to this precise 64km sub-segment on its own, but together (groundbreaking on the parent program + active EIA/procedural progress on this named sub-segment, no cancellation signal in either) they support 'construction' as the correct status; tier high given two independent working sources both naming the correct project family.

Both sources are explicitly about a 天然气 (natural gas) pipeline: the Sina article's headline/body is '来宾天然气支线管道工程' (Laibin natural-gas branch pipeline project) with design annual gas-transmission capacity given in m3; the Laibin Daily notice title is '广西天然气支线管网项目来宾天然气支线管道工程（兴宾-武宣段）'. Fuel=Gas is unambiguous and confirmed by both independent sources.

Sina article describes a 支线管道 (branch pipeline) running station-to-station (Laibin distribution/dispatch station -> new Wuxuan/Xiangzhou/Jinxiu distribution stations) at a stated design pressure of 4.0 MPa -- a high-pressure long-haul specification consistent with transmission, not local low-pressure distribution mains. Laibin Daily's EIA notice covers the same project as one continuous pipeline engineering work (管道工程), not a gathering/process facility. Matches the prior deep-sweep auditor's independent conclusion (rows/P7690.json) that this is correctly classified as a transmission branch line, not gathering/process.

No source found dating a January 2023 proposal/approval action specifically for this segment. The two segment-relevant sources found bracket 2023 loosely but don't hit month=1: Sina reports the parent program's groundbreaking on 2022-12-20 (before, not at, ProposalYear/Month), and the Laibin Daily EIA public-comment notice is dated 2023-08-09 (after). The dead current_ref's web.archive.org snapshot (20250413122044) turned out to be a generic Guangxi DRC 2023 province-wide energy-infrastructure work-plan notice (成文日期 2023-03-25, 发布日期 2023-04-03) with no segment-specific text -- also not January and not citable as segment-specific support. This session's web-search budget was exhausted before a targeted search for a Jan-2023 NDRC/发改 core-approval (核准/备案) document could be run, so treating as UNRESOLVED rather than guessing; a follow-up pass with search budget could target '兴宾-武宣段 核准 2023年1月' / '桂发改' filings.

Recorded value is 0.30 bcm/y for this Xingbin-Wuxuan sub-segment. The only capacity figure found, in the verified Sina article, is for the WHOLE 148km branch (Laibin station through Wuxuan/Xiangzhou to Jinxiu): '年设计输气能力1.87亿立方米' = 0.187 bcm/y design capacity for the entire route -- lower than, and inconsistent with, GEM's 0.30 bcm/y figure for just one upstream sub-segment of that same route (an upstream segment's throughput capacity should not normally exceed the whole route's design figure). Per standing instructions, not proposing this source as a ref for the recorded 0.30 value since it disagrees; flagging the discrepancy (also already flagged by the prior deep-sweep auditor in rows/P7690.json) rather than silently citing a source that supports a different number. No segment-specific capacity document was found before the web-search budget was exhausted.

Sina article states the design pressure for the overall Laibin-branch engineering project (of which this Xingbin-Wuxuan run is one sub-segment) as '设计压力4.0兆帕' -- an exact match to the recorded 4.00 MPa. Design pressure is normally set once for a continuous pipeline design and carries uniformly across its sub-segments, so this is treated as supporting evidence for this segment's value, but downgraded to tier=medium/single-source (not independent) because it is a route-level figure rather than a document naming this sub-segment's pressure explicitly, and no second source stating the pressure was found.

Recorded value is 64.00 km for the Xingbin-Wuxuan sub-segment. The verified Sina article gives only the WHOLE branch length: '管道线路全长约148公里' (route total ~148km, Laibin station through Wuxuan/Xiangzhou to Jinxiu) -- consistent with 64km being plausible as one portion of that 148km total, but not a citable confirmation of the 64km sub-segment figure itself. No document giving a length specifically for the Xingbin-Wuxuan portion was found (matches the prior deep-sweep auditor's same finding in rows/P7690.json); web-search budget was exhausted before further targeted queries could run. Leaving UNRESOLVED rather than citing the whole-route figure against a sub-segment value.

Recorded value is Diameter=250 (mm). The verified Sina article gives the pipe diameter for the overall branch project as '管径内径273.1毫米' (273.1mm) -- this is the standard Chinese OD figure for nominal DN250 pipe, and disagrees with the bare 250 recorded on the row (the prior deep-sweep auditor flagged this exact DN-vs-OD mismatch as a likely data-entry issue in rows/P7690.json, recommending 273.10 as the correction). Per standing instructions, not citing this source against the recorded 250 value since it disagrees -- a value change is a separate workflow decision, not something to paper over with a mismatched ref. No source giving exactly 250mm for this segment was found.

Laibin Daily's EIA public-comment notice title names this exact sub-segment: '来宾天然气支线管道工程（兴宾-武宣段）' = 'Laibin natural-gas branch pipeline project (Xingbin-Wuxuan segment)' -- a direct match to StartLocation=Xingbin/EndLocation=Wuxuan (both Laibin prefecture, Guangxi, China). Sina's groundbreaking article independently corroborates the route order, describing it running through 兴宾(Xingbin)、武宣(Wuxuan)、象州(Xiangzhou)、金秀(Jinxiu) in that sequence from the Laibin dispatch station. Two independent sources both confirming Xingbin precedes Wuxuan on this named route.

Recorded value is RMB 180,000,000 (2023) for this sub-segment. The verified Sina article gives only a WHOLE-route investment figure: '投资4.78亿元' (RMB 478 million) for the entire 148km Laibin-Xiangzhou-Jinxiu branch -- not a document that isolates cost for just the 64km Xingbin-Wuxuan portion. A rough proportional split (64/148 x 478M ~ RMB 207M) is in the same order of magnitude as the recorded 180M but that is arithmetic inference, not a citable source stating the segment cost, so not proposing it as a ref. No segment-specific cost document was found before the web-search budget was exhausted.

Laibin Daily's EIA notice explicitly names the construction unit: '建设单位 广西燃气集团有限公司' = 'Construction unit: Guangxi Gas Group Co., Ltd.' -- an exact match to Operator/OperatorLocalLanguage on the row. Sina's article independently corroborates: the groundbreaking was for '广西燃气集团来宾天然气支线管道工程' (Guangxi Gas Group's Laibin natural-gas branch pipeline project). Two independent sources, both naming the operator explicitly; current_ref was blank so this fully resolves the gap.

Same two sources as Operator support Owner1=Guangxi Gas Group Co Ltd at 100%: Laibin Daily names 广西燃气集团有限公司 as the sole construction/建设单位 for this exact segment's EIA filing, and Sina's groundbreaking article identifies the project as 广西燃气集团's own branch-pipeline build with no other party named. No indication of a co-owner in either source, consistent with 100% single ownership.
